transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

What finally made me call the employee assistance program was my sleep. I lie awake replaying work stuff and arguments at home, then I wake up around three or four and can’t really get back to sleep. I start the day feeling like I never rested.
Aside from the sleep problems, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?
Yeah. Most days there’s this heavy, gray feeling that follows me from work to the car to home. Even when nothing particular is going on, I just feel kind of hollow.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and two months, I’d say. It really started around when the arguments at home got a lot worse.
Before this started about a year ago, have you ever had another period in your life where you felt this depressed?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time that felt like this.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities and hobbies you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to pickup basketball, bowling nights, music festivals, having friends over and using the smoker. Lately I either cancel, or I go and it just feels like I’m going through the motions.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or unintentional changes in your weight?
Yeah. My appetite’s been off for months. I’ll just have coffee and not eat lunch, then pick at dinner with my family. I’ve noticed my belt is a notch tighter than it used to be.
How have your energy levels been throughout the day?
I’m not really sure what to compare it to. I guess I haven’t paid much attention to my energy specifically.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing on things, whether at work or at home?

Yeah, especially at work. I used to get through sales forecasts and client decks pretty quickly, but now I’ll read the same slide over and over, second-guess the numbers, and still have trouble deciding what I want to say.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, or feeling like you are letting people down or blaming yourself excessively?
Yeah. I keep going over all the late nights at work, the tailgates, dumb stuff I’ve spent money on. I end up thinking my wife and kids got stuck with a selfish guy who keeps letting them down.
